item.title: 【農業】 Power representation in food systems
item.description: Systems modelling and power mapping illuminate different dimensions of power in food systems but are rarely used to interrogate one another. This Comment proposes recursive representational revision, a methodological approach that organizes iterative engagement between the two so that each becomes a resource for revising
